summary: Stephen C. Berkwitz works in religious and Buddhist studies. He studied at the University of Kelaniya (1995–1997) and held posts at the University of Colombo, Ruhr University Bochum, and Missouri State University (attested 2004).

Stephen F. Teiser specializes in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. He studied at Oberlin College and Princeton University under Alan Sponberg, Denis Twitchett, and Daniel L. Overmyer. He taught at Middlebury College (~1986–1988) and Princeton University from ~1988.

Stephen Fuchs (1908–2000) was an Indologist and religious studies scholar. He earned his Ph.D. at the University of Vienna (~1948–1950) under Wilhelm Schmidt. He taught at St. Xavier's College, Mumbai (1950–1954) and the University of San Carlos (1961–1962).

Stephen G. Covell is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Japanology, and religious studies. He completed his doctoral studies at Princeton University (~1995–2001) under Jacqueline I. Stone and took up a post at Western Michigan University in ~2003.

Stephen H. West is a Sinologist who studied at National Taiwan Normal University and earned his Ph.D. at the University of Michigan (~1968–1972). He held posts at UC Berkeley (~1986–2002), the IUP (~1996–2001), and Arizona State University (~2002–2017).

Stephen J. Laumakis specializes in philosophy and Buddhist studies. He studied under John Kronen, Ramdas Lamb, George J. Tanabe, and David West, and served as Associate Professor of Philosophy at the University of St. Thomas (attested 2008–2013).

Stephen L. Jenkins (1953–2016) worked in Buddhist and religious studies. He studied at Harvard University under Charles Hallisey and Masatoshi Nagatomi, among others, and served as Professor of Religious Studies at California State Polytechnic University, Humboldt (attested 2010–2013).

Stephen Prothero is a religious studies scholar who earned degrees from Yale University and Harvard University, completing his Ph.D. under William R. Hutchison (~1986–1990). He has held a professorship at Boston University since ~1996.

Stephen R. Bokenkamp is a Sinologist and religious studies scholar who studied at UC Berkeley (~1976–1986). He held posts at Indiana University (~1989–2007), the Australian National University (1999), and Arizona State University (~2007).
Stephen Suen is a scholar of Buddhist studies who earned his PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2009) under the supervision of K. L. Dhammajoti.

Stephen Wootton Bushell (1844–1908) was a Sinologist and historian/archaeologist. He completed his medical studies at the University of London (~1862–1868) and held posts at Guy's Hospital (1866) and Bethlem Royal Hospital (1867).

Steve Odin is a scholar of philosophy and Japanology. He completed graduate and postdoctoral studies at Stony Brook University (~1976–1982) under David A. Dilworth and Edward S. Casey, and became a Professor of Philosophy at the University of Hawaiʻi in 1982.

Steven Collins (1950–2018) was a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar. He earned his D.Phil. at Oxford (~1974–1979) under Richard Gombrich. He taught at Oxford, the University of Bristol (~1980–1991), and the University of Chicago from 1991.

Steven Edward Lindquist specializes in Indology and religious studies. He completed his Ph.D. at the University of Texas at Austin in 2005 under Patrick Olivelle, alongside several traditional teachers, and held a post at Concordia University.

Steven Heine is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Japanology, and religious studies. Educated at the University of Pennsylvania and Temple University, he held posts at Villanova (1982–1987), La Salle (1987–1991), Penn State (~1991–1997), and Florida International University (1997).

Steven Lukes is a philosopher and sociologist who studied at Oxford under E. E. Evans-Pritchard. He held posts at Balliol College (1966–1987), Florence (~1987–1995), Siena (~1995–2000), LSE (~1999–2001), and New York University (~2001–2021).

Steven Neal Weinberger specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Amherst College and the University of Virginia, completing his PhD under Jeffrey Hopkins in 2003, and held an attested post at the University of Virginia in 2006.

Sthaneshwar Timalsina is a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. He studied at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg, later holding posts at Nepal Sanskrit University (~1988–2002), San Diego State University (~2005–2022), and Stony Brook University (~2022).

Stig Wikander (1908–1983) was a scholar of Indology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and religion. He studied at Uppsala under Henrik Samuel Nyberg, later serving as docent at Lund (1941–1953) and holding a chair at Uppsala (1953–1974).

Stuart H. Blackburn is an Indologist who studied at Wesleyan University (~1965–1969) and the University of California, Berkeley (~1974–1980). He held a post at SOAS University of London from ~1994 to 2011.
